Summary: BUG-01: CV upload of a file of exactly 5 MB (and 5 MB - 1 byte) is rejected with HTTP 413
Description:
*Module:* Student profile / CV upload
*Severity:* Major
*Found with:* BVA (TC-BB-CV-04, TC-BB-CV-05)

*Steps to reproduce*
1. Sign in as a student.
2. POST /api/student/profile/cv with a 5,242,880-byte PDF.

*Expected:* HTTP 200 - README says CVs up to 5 MB are allowed.
*Actual:* HTTP 413 Payload Too Large. Even 5,242,879 bytes fails.

*Root cause:* spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size=5MB limits the WHOLE multipart request. The request also contains boundaries and part headers (~200 bytes), so a file near 5 MB pushes the request over the limit before the file-size rule is checked.

*Fix:* max-request-size raised to 6MB; max-file-size stays 5MB (application.properties). Regression test TC-BB-CV-01..06 now passes.

Summary: BUG-02: A REJECTED application can be moved back to INTERVIEW or UNDER_REVIEW
Description:
*Module:* Company / application review
*Severity:* Major
*Found with:* State-transition analysis, fixed with TDD

*Steps to reproduce*
1. Company rejects an application (PATCH /status REJECTED).
2. PATCH /status INTERVIEW on the same application.

*Expected:* HTTP 409 - a rejected student must not be re-invited by mistake.
*Actual:* HTTP 200 - status changed to INTERVIEW; the student sees an interview invitation after being rejected.

*Root cause:* ApplicationService.updateStatus() only checked the TARGET status, never the CURRENT status. No state machine was designed for applications.

*Fix:* New ApplicationStatusTransitions class written test-first (TDD) and called from updateStatus(); returns 409 for illegal moves. Regression tests API-09 and Cucumber outline.

Summary: BUG-03: Password characters after the 72nd byte are ignored - a different password can sign in
Description:
*Module:* Authentication
*Severity:* Critical
*Found with:* BVA on bytes vs characters (TC-BB-PW-MB)

*Steps to reproduce*
1. Register with password = 24 Sinhala letters + 'secret' (30 chars, 90 bytes).
2. Log in with 24 Sinhala letters + 'WRONG!'.

*Expected:* HTTP 401 - wrong password.
*Actual:* HTTP 200 - login succeeds and a JWT is issued.

*Root cause:* BCrypt only uses the first 72 BYTES of a password. Validation (@Size max=72) counts CHARACTERS. Sinhala/Tamil letters are 3 bytes in UTF-8, so a 30-letter password is 90 bytes and the last 18 bytes are silently dropped.

*Fix:* Proposed: validate UTF-8 byte length <= 72 (custom validator) or pre-hash with SHA-256 before bcrypt / use Argon2PasswordEncoder.

Summary: BUG-04: No brute-force protection: unlimited wrong-password attempts are allowed
Description:
*Module:* Authentication
*Severity:* Major
*Found with:* OWASP A07 check (SEC-13)

*Steps to reproduce*
Send 11 wrong passwords for the same account in a row.

*Expected:* After 10 failures the account is throttled (HTTP 429) or locked for a short time.
*Actual:* Every attempt returns 401 and attempts are never limited.

*Root cause:* No rate limiting or failed-attempt counter was designed into AuthService (security requirement missing in the original spec).

*Fix:* Proposed: count failures per e-mail/IP (e.g. Bucket4j) and return 429 for 15 minutes after 10 failures.

Summary: BUG-05: E-mail without a domain suffix (nimal@localhost) is accepted at registration
Description:
*Module:* Registration
*Severity:* Minor
*Found with:* Equivalence partitioning (TC-BB-EM-OBS)

*Steps to reproduce*
Register with e-mail 'nimal@localhost'.

*Expected:* HTTP 400 - invalid e-mail.
*Actual:* HTTP 201 - account created.

*Root cause:* Jakarta @Email follows RFC rules where a dot-less domain is legal.

*Fix:* Proposed: @Email(regexp = ".+@.+\\..+") on RegisterRequest.email.

Summary: BUG-06: Vacancy deadline has no upper limit (year 9999 accepted)
Description:
*Module:* Company / vacancies
*Severity:* Minor
*Found with:* BVA on date (TC-BB-DL-OBS)

*Steps to reproduce*
Create a vacancy with deadline 9999-12-31.

*Expected:* HTTP 400 (e.g. max 1 year ahead).
*Actual:* HTTP 201 - vacancy stays open forever.

*Root cause:* Only @FutureOrPresent is applied; no maximum was specified.

*Fix:* Proposed: custom validator - deadline <= today + 365 days.

Summary: BUG-07: CV content type is trusted from the client - HTML renamed to .pdf is stored and served as text/html
Description:
*Module:* Student profile / CV upload
*Severity:* Major
*Found with:* OWASP A04 Insecure Design (SEC-14)

*Steps to reproduce*
Upload 'cv.pdf' whose body is <script>alert(1)</script> with Content-Type text/html.

*Expected:* HTTP 400 - file is not a real PDF/DOC/DOCX.
*Actual:* HTTP 200 - file stored; download returns Content-Type text/html.

*Root cause:* StudentProfileService only checks the file NAME extension and copies the client's Content-Type header.

*Fix:* Proposed: check magic bytes (%PDF, D0CF11E0, PK) with Apache Tika and set the content type on the server.

Summary: BUG-08: Deadline checks use the server time zone (UTC on Render) instead of Asia/Colombo
Description:
*Module:* Vacancies / applications
*Severity:* Minor
*Found with:* White-box code review (static)

*Steps to reproduce*
Deploy on Render (UTC). Vacancy deadline = 24 Nov. At 25 Nov 02:00 Sri Lanka time, apply.

*Expected:* HTTP 409 - deadline passed in Sri Lanka.
*Actual:* Application accepted until 05:30 SL time because UTC date is still 24 Nov.

*Root cause:* ApplicationService.apply() and VacancyService use LocalDate.now() (JVM zone) while scheduleInterview() uses Asia/Colombo - inconsistent design.

*Fix:* Proposed: one Clock bean with ZoneId Asia/Colombo injected into all services.

Summary: BUG-09: Public endpoints (login, health) return 401 when an expired/invalid Bearer token is sent
Description:
*Module:* Security configuration
*Severity:* Minor
*Found with:* Found while building the JMeter script

*Steps to reproduce*
POST /api/auth/login with header 'Authorization: Bearer expired.token.value'.

*Expected:* HTTP 200 - login is public.
*Actual:* HTTP 401 - API clients holding an old token cannot log in again.

*Root cause:* Spring's BearerTokenAuthenticationFilter validates any Authorization header before permitAll() rules are applied.

*Fix:* Proposed: ignore the bearer token on public paths (custom BearerTokenResolver).
